Compose_Approver_Upn.description: Pilot - fixed approver. Phase 3.2 will resolve dynamic manager via Office 365 Users Manager_V2 once the shared_office365users connection is set up.

Compose_Variables_Object.description: Parse RITM Variables JSON once so approval details can render friendly field labels instead of raw JSON. Plain-text or empty Variables values are treated as an empty object so approval creation is not blocked.

Get_License_Costs.description: Runtime lookup of license SKU part number to approver-friendly product name from the License Costs SharePoint list.

Compose_License_Display_Name.description: Use the License Costs SharePoint list Title as the friendly license name; fall back to skuPartNumber if no mapping exists.

Compose_Approval_Details.description: Human-readable approval body. Keep field labels explicit so approvers do not see raw Variables JSON.

parameters.item/WorkNotes: @{concat('Approved by ', outputs('Compose_Approver_Upn'), ' at ', utcNow(), '. Comments: ', coalesce(first(body('Wait_For_Approval')?['responses'])?['comments'], '(none)'), '. Spawning ', string(length(if(empty(coalesce(body('Get_Catalog_Item')?['TaskTemplates'], '')), createArray(1), json(body('Get_Catalog_Item')?['TaskTemplates'])))), ' SCTASK(s).')}

parameters.item/Description: @{concat('Auto-generated from catalog item ', body('Get_Catalog_Item')?['Title'], '. Approved by ', outputs('Compose_Approver_Upn'), '. JobType: ', coalesce(items('ForEach_Spawn_SCTASK')?['jobType'], ''))}

@{concat('

Request approved

RITM: ', triggerOutputs()?['body/RitmNumber'], ' (item ID ', string(triggerOutputs()?['body/ID']), ')

Parent ticket item ID: ', string(triggerOutputs()?['body/ParentTicket/Id']), '

Catalog item: ', body('Get_Catalog_Item')?['ItemName'], '

Approved by: ', outputs('Compose_Approver_Upn'), '

Approved at: ', utcNow(), '

Next step: SCTASK records were created and automation will continue from the task bridge.

Open request item

')}
